name: NEXT_{dist}_km_YELLOWGREEN_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA113-1: W8-SA113-1B 750 x 500 illustrated (A 600 x 400; PNG W8-SA113-1A.png), fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30. Chain 94 / 125 / 62 / 125 / 94: NEXT 125 E top 94, 461 (144/461/145); distance numerals '125 EM' ('varies', dashed box; the line is centred as a whole, '=' margins on the sheet), 60 gap, km '105 EM' (lower case 75) 217 wide, baseline 406. The sheet gives no example: generated at 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 km — not confirmed against SA practice.
